caption: The drawing features a stylized brown carousel horse with a black mane and tail, standing on three legs with the front right leg raised and the head turned upwards and to the viewer's left. The horse is adorned with a turquoise saddle blanket bordered in gold and decorated with a yellowish-brown saddle, harness straps, and blue and gold embellishments on the harness and bridle. There are metal stirrups hanging down on both sides of the horse. The background is a plain, light beige color with visible speckles and stains, set within a thin, rectangular red border. In the lower left corner, there is a small inset line drawing showing a simplified side view of the same horse, complete with proportions, and marked with an arrow and the measurement “39 in.” The artist’s information, "ERNEST A. TOWER JR." and reference numbers, are indicated in small print near the lower right side of the main drawing.
title: Carousel Horse
